closeout_decision.rationale: Session-scoped fixtures are limited to immutable bootstrap catalog metadata (BootstrapMetadataCache / CachedBootstrapMetadata). Mutable pipeline/provider registries remain function-scoped clones via fresh_pipeline_registry and fresh_provider_registry. Isolation proof lives in test_bootstrap_metadata_cache_isolation.py.
